verdict.rationale: Postman runs whole collections of requests in one pass from the CLI, Newman and CI/CD, which is a form of batch execution. Its Postman API lets users manage assets programmatically, so bulk changes could be scripted. However, no evidence shows a dedicated bulk-edit or bulk-mutation capability across many items, by UI, API or Agent Mode. Missing for 10: explicit bulk operations on many items (batch create, update or delete of collections, requests, environments or workspaces), documented bulk API endpoints, evidence that Agent Mode applies changes across many items at once, and independent hands-on corroboration.
